answer: Anchor each identity to a sequential delay puzzle: at epoch start every agent must finish a verifiable delay function keyed to its own address and the fresh epoch seed, taking ten minutes of sequential steps no parallel farm can shorten. That kernel of forced waiting is the tide every identity must swim alone: one computation cannot serve two addresses, and the fresh seed makes precomputation worthless. A thousand fakes need a thousand ten-minute runs on a thousand cores, so the nectar of mining rewards goes only to those who paid real time; verification is one cheap check of the proof.
